function onLoad(save)
   positions = {{-6.38, 1.03, 19.13},{-1.28, 1.03, 19.13},{3.83, 1.03, 19.13},{-6.38, 1.03, 11.48},{-1.28, 1.03, 11.48},{3.83, 1.03, 11.48},{-6.38, 1.03, 3.83},
   {-1.28, 1.03, 3.83},{3.83, 1.03, 3.83},{-6.38, 1.03, -3.83},{-1.28, 1.03, -3.83},{3.83, 1.03, -3.83}}
   self.createButton({
      click_function = "ResetGame",
      function_owner = self,
      label          = "初始化",
      position       = {0,0.2,0},
      rotation = {0,-90,0},
      width          = 1350,
      height         = 600,
   })
   discardBox = getObjectFromGUID("8ea3a6")
end

function ResetGame(obj, col, alt)
   for i,v in pairs(discardBox.getObjects()) do
      discardBox.takeObject({
         position          = {-31.88, 1.51, 8.93},
         rotation          = {0.00, 180.00, 180.00},
         smooth            = false,
      })
   end
   for i,v in pairs(getAllObjects()) do
      if v.tag == "Card" or v.tag == "Deck" then
         v.setPosition({-31.88, 1.51, 8.93})
         v.setRotation({0.00, 180.00, 180.00})
      end
   end
   local deck
   for i,v in pairs(getAllObjects()) do
      if v.tag == "Deck" then --lazy here
         deck = v
      end
   end
   if deck ~= nil then
      for i,v in pairs(positions) do
         deck.takeObject({
            position          = v,
            smooth            = true,
            flip              = true,
         })
      end
   end
end
